name: Tucker Kraft

background.fact: Tucker John Kraft was born November 3, 2000, in Timber Lake, South Dakota, and grew up on the Cheyenne River Sioux Tribe Reservation. In April 2024 he was named an honorary tribal member for his acts of service to the community, and he wears a tribal flag on his helmet.

At Timber Lake High School he played running back, middle linebacker and punter; as a senior he rushed for 1,405 yards and 24 touchdowns and was first team All-State. He committed to South Dakota State over a late Wyoming offer.
At South Dakota State he redshirted, then as a redshirt sophomore started all 15 games with 65 catches for 780 yards and 6 touchdowns, and was a consensus FCS All-American.
Green Bay drafted him in the third round (pick 78) of the 2023 NFL draft. Listed at 6 ft 5 in, 259 lb, number 85, age 26, depth chart TE1, fourth NFL season.

background.fact: Combine numbers: 4.69 forty, 34 inch vertical, 122 inch broad jump. Madden week 8 rating is 83 overall with 91 catching and 88 speed.

family.fact: His father, Doug Kraft, died in 2013. He has two brothers, Cody and Tanner.
He married Baylee Jandahl, a graphic designer, on May 18, 2024. They became parents of a daughter, Charlotte, in early 2025. Nothing further about the child is recorded here.
